app.name: Monggle
app.tagline: Mongolia, together. Pay the flight first, the rest via Toss before departure
app.description: Mongolia companion packages for people in their 20s and 30s. Find a group that matches your travel style and lock your seat by paying only the flight portion.

home.title: Stars, steppe, ger. To Mongolia with people like you

steps.deposit: Pay the flight portion to lock your seat
steps.installments: Rest paid via Toss before departure (card installments available)

packages.heading: Packages
packages.lead: Per person, 6 people sharing a vehicle. Estimated incl. flight; each departure has its own fixed price.
packages.depositHint: The flight portion. Your seat is confirmed as soon as it's paid.

detail.noDepartures: No departures scheduled yet. Coming soon.
detail.remaining: Remainder paid via Toss by 7 days before departure, card installments available
detail.priceNote: Estimate. The exact price is shown when you pick a departure.
detail.routeNote: Approximate route. The order of stops can change with local conditions.

join.heading: Join this departure
join.scheduleHint: We never charge your card ourselves. Every payment goes through Toss Payments.
join.payInFull: Departure is close, so the remainder is paid together with the deposit.
join.seatHold: Your seat is confirmed as soon as the deposit is paid.
join.remainderHow: Paid through Toss Payments. You can choose interest-free card installments there.
join.loginFirst: Log in to join this departure.

login.heading: Log in
login.lead: This is the demo. Enter a name to log in. The real service uses Kakao or Naver accounts.
login.name: Name (shown to your group)

pay.heading: Checkout
pay.demoNote: Demo checkout. In the real service the Toss Payments window opens and card details are entered at Toss only.
pay.installmentNote: Interest-free installments are provided by the card issuer. We charge no interest or fees.

my.heading: My trips

my.paidBanner: Payment complete. Your seat is confirmed!

group.notMember: Join this departure to see the chat and checklist.
group.matchHint: Fill in your travel style under Find companions to see per-member matches

match.heading: Find companions like me
match.lead: Answer 7 questions and we'll rank departure groups by fit. MBTI is optional.
match.mbtiHint: Leave blank if unsure. For travel we weigh N/S and J/P most.
match.resultsLead: Ranked by fit with members who already joined. Empty departures: you'd be the first.
